packet.headline_seed: Israel says new head of Hamas' military wing killed in Gaza City strikes
packet.description_seed: At least three people were killed in the attacks, which came despite a ceasefire with Hamas being in place.

what: Israel says new head of Hamas' military wing killed in Gaza City strikes

clean_source_blocks.text: DEIR AL-BALAH, Gaza Strip (AP) — Israel carried out a pair of airstrikes in Gaza City late Tuesday, killing at least three people and injuring 12, hospital officials said. The strike took place on the eve of Eid al-Adha, a major Muslim holiday. In a joint statement, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and his defense minister, Israel Katz, said the strikes had targeted the new leader of Hamas' military wing. They identified him as Mohammed Odeh and called him “one of the architects” of the Oct. 7, 2023, attacks that triggered over two years of war. The strike came less than two weeks after Israel killed the previous head of Hamas' military wing, Izz al-Din al-Haddad. There was no immediate comment from Hamas. The bodies of the dead were taken to Gaza's Shifa Hospital, which confirmed the deaths.

Israel says it has killed Hamas's armed wing commander Mohammed Odeh in a strike in Gaza on Tuesday - days after his predecessor died in a similar attack. At least three Palestinians were killed and dozens more were injured in Tuesday's major attack, which targeted a residential building in one of Gaza City's busiest market areas, local medics and witnesses said. The Israeli security agency, known as Shin Bet, and its military said in a statement that buildings that served as a hideout for Odeh were targeted after his movements were tracked for several months. It is the latest deadly Israeli strike on Gaza despite a ceasefire with Hamas being in place.
At least three people were killed in the attacks, which came despite a ceasefire with Hamas being in place.

The attack came on the eve of Eid al-Adha, normally a joyous time of family gatherings and large meals. The holiday once again is subdued this year in Gaza, where the vast majority of people remain displaced and live in tents or temporary shelters after a devastating war. A ceasefire reached between Israel and Hamas last October remains fragile. Israeli attacks have killed more than 880 Palestinians since the ceasefire took effect. Israel says its attacks are in response to violations by Hamas or threats to its soldiers, but Palestinian health officials says scores of civilians have been among the dead. Four Israeli soldiers have also been killed during this period. Israel launched its offensive in Gaza in response to the Hamas attacks in October 2023, which killed some 1,200 people and took 250 others hostage.

[Lähde: BBC World]
Israel says it has killed Hamas's armed wing commander Mohammed Odeh in a strike in Gaza on Tuesday - days after his predecessor died in a similar attack.

At least three Palestinians were killed and dozens more were injured in Tuesday's major attack, which targeted a residential building in one of Gaza City's busiest market areas, local medics and witnesses said.

The Israeli security agency, known as Shin Bet, and its military said in a statement that buildings that served as a hideout for Odeh were targeted after his movements were tracked for several months.

It is the latest deadly Israeli strike on Gaza despite a ceasefire with Hamas being in place.

The strike hit the upper three floors of the al-Kayali building in the centre of Gaza City, where streets were busy with shoppers ahead of the Muslim holiday Eid al-Adha.

The Israeli Defense Forces (IDF) and Shin Bet said: "As part of the joint operation by the IDF and Shin Bet to eliminate the terrorist Muhammad Odeh, several buildings in the heart of Gaza City that served as a hideout for him were attacked, after months of intelligence surveillance in order to track his movements and the movements of his assistants in the organisation."

They added that that they had also struck "a nearby apartment belonging to a Hamas terrorist who raided on October 7 and was part of Odeh's circle of assistants".

Rescue teams rushed to the scene of the strikes but struggled to reach the upper floors because of the scale of the damage and congestion in the area.

Witnesses said at least five missiles struck the building almost simultaneously from different directions.

One resident said he heard the sound of helicopter hovering overhead before the attack.

Footage from the scene showed ambulances and civil defence crews searching through the damaged building as crowds gathered nearby.

"Odeh was responsible for the murder, abduction, and wounding of many Israeli citizens and IDF soldiers," the statement continued.

His predecessor as commander of the group's armed wing, Izz ad-Din al-Haddad, was killed in another Israeli air strike earlier in May.

That attack also targeted a residential building and killed at least three people, according to eyewitnesses and a local source.

payload.title: Israel sanoo surmanneensa Hamasin aseellisen siiven uuden johtajan Gazassa
payload.summary: Israel kertoo surmanneensa Mohammed Odehin ilmaiskuissa Gazan kaupungissa. Paikallisten sairaalatietojen mukaan iskuissa kuoli ainakin kolme ihmistä ja useita haavoittui, vaikka Israelin ja Hamasin välillä on voimassa hauras tulitauko.
payload.content:
Israel sanoo surmanneensa Hamasin aseellisen siiven komentajan Mohammed Odehin tiistaisissa ilmaiskuissa Gazan kaupungissa. Paikallisten lääkintäviranomaisten mukaan iskuissa kuoli ainakin kolme palestiinalaista ja haavoittui useita muita. Iskut tehtiin tilanteessa, jossa Israelin ja Hamasin välillä on voimassa hauras tulitauko.

## Iskut osuivat vilkkaalle alueelle

Paikallisten lääkintäviranomaisten ja silminnäkijöiden mukaan iskujen kohteena oli asuinrakennus Gazan kaupungin vilkkaalla markkina-alueella. Sairaalalähteiden mukaan ainakin kolme ihmistä kuoli ja 12 haavoittui. Kuolleiden ruumiit vietiin Shifan sairaalaan, joka vahvisti kuolemat.

Israelin turvallisuuspalvelu Shin Bet ja armeija sanoivat lausunnossaan, että iskujen kohteena olivat rakennukset, joita Odehin väitettiin käyttäneen piilopaikkana. Israelin mukaan hänen liikkeitään oli seurattu useiden kuukausien ajan.

Pääministeri Benjamin Netanyahu ja puolustusministeri Israel Katz sanoivat yhteisessä lausunnossaan, että Odeh oli Hamasin aseellisen siiven uusi johtaja. He kuvasivat häntä yhdeksi 7. lokakuuta 2023 tehtyjen hyökkäysten suunnittelijoista. Hamas ei kommentoinut väitettä välittömästi.

## Tulitauko pysyy hauraana

Isku tapahtui vain alle kaksi viikkoa sen jälkeen, kun Israel kertoi surmanneensa Hamasin aseellisen siiven aiemman johtajan Izz al-Din al-Haddadin vastaavanlaisessa hyökkäyksessä.

Tiistain isku tehtiin Eid al-Adhan aattona. Juhla on tavallisesti perheiden kokoontumisen ja yhteisten aterioiden aikaa, mutta Gazassa olosuhteet ovat yhä poikkeuksellisen vaikeat. Suuri osa alueen väestöstä on edelleen siirtynyt kodeistaan ja asuu teltoissa tai väliaikaisissa suojissa.

Israel ja Hamas saavuttivat tulitauon viime lokakuussa, mutta se on pysynyt kireänä. Palestiinalaisten terveysviranomaisten mukaan Israelin iskut ovat surmanneet yli 880 palestiinalaista tulitauon voimaantulon jälkeen, ja kuolleiden joukossa on ollut myös siviilejä. Israelin mukaan sen iskut ovat vastauksia Hamasin rikkomuksiin tai uhkiin sen sotilaita vastaan. Samalla ajanjaksolla on kuollut myös neljä israelilaissotilasta.

Israel aloitti sotilasoperaationsa Gazassa Hamasin lokakuussa 2023 tekemien hyökkäysten jälkeen. Hyökkäyksissä kuoli noin 1 200 ihmistä ja noin 250 otettiin panttivangeiksi.
summary_bullets: Israel sanoo surmanneensa Hamasin aseellisen siiven komentajan Mohammed Odehin Gazan kaupungissa.
Paikallisten sairaalatietojen mukaan iskuissa kuoli ainakin kolme ihmistä ja 12 haavoittui.
Iskut tehtiin hauraan tulitauon aikana ja Eid al-Adhan aattona.
payload.journalist_note: Artikkeli perustuu lähdepaketin tietoihin. Hamasin kommenttia ei ollut saatavilla lähdeaineistossa, ja Israelin väite Odehin asemasta ja kuolemasta on esitetty Israelin ilmoituksena.
